messages:
Taylor Brooks: Hey team, quick q from my first week: where do I post common onboarding issues (VPN, laptop requests, infra access)? Also which bots are safe to try vs avoid?
Nina Flores: Welcome! Short map: laptop & HR -> #people-ops (use the pinned request form). VPN/access -> #eng-infra or open the SSO access ticket linked in #help.
Taylor Brooks: Cool. If something blocks me now (no VPN), where do I yell?
Marcus Lee: Post in #help and mention @eng-oncall if it's blocking. That channel is monitored during working hours.
Taylor Brooks: Got it. About bots 94 I saw an emoji-bot in #random. Safe?
Nina Flores: If it's labeled sandbox or experimental in the app details, it's fine. Otherwise treat unknown bots like any app: dont run slash commands in public unless you know what they do. We have #devex-sandbox for testing.
Ops Bot: Hi Taylor! For hardware swaps file a ticket at https://peopleops.internal/tickets. For onboarding checklist use `/onboard me` to get a DM.
Taylor Brooks: Any short etiquette reminders so I don't annoy folks?
Marcus Lee: TL;DR: search first, pick the narrowest channel, use threads, include what you tried, paste short logs (fenced), never paste secrets, and escalate with @mention if it blocks you.
Nina Flores: Example error post for #eng: "@eng build failing on macbook-pro-2020, ran `make build`, error below" + 5-10 line code block. For long traces use an unlisted gist.
Taylor Brooks: Thanks! One more: if I accidentally post a secret?
Marcus Lee: Delete it, rotate creds, and ping #eng-security. There's a secrets-rotation playbook pinned in that channel.
Taylor Brooks: Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll use #help and #devex-sandbox for bots. :thumbsup:
